clips.title: The story
paras: Takata Steelblade is an orc warrior stationed at Ghost Walker Post in Desolace. Dispatched from Orgrimmar by Keldran alongside Maurin Bonesplitter, he spearheads the Horde's local campaign against demonic corruption. His primary focus is eradicating the regional satyr population affiliated with the sinister Burning Blade.

Takata Steelblade was sent from the capital to Desolace under direct orders from Keldran, an influential figure in Orgrimmar committed to uncovering and purging demonic subversion. Operating out of the isolated Tauren encampment of Ghost Walker Post, Takata coordinates military efforts against the Legion-aligned forces plaguing the barren wastes.

While his companion Maurin Bonesplitter attempts to track and dismantle the clandestine Burning Blade cultists directly, Takata focuses on their demonic allies: the satyrs. Takata has orchestrated aggressive strikes against Desolace's corrupted satyrs, decimating their ranks to break the cult's local power structure and halt their spreading taint.
